subject.title: backup create stalls on large installations (4GB+ .openclaw dir)

question: What restore-safe native backup scope should OpenClaw support for large state directories before this issue can close?
rationale: The remaining fix likely adds public CLI flags/defaults and changes which local state enters recovery archives, which is a product and security tradeoff automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Review the linked native PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a replacement branch as the review vehicle, requiring real large-state proof and explicit decisions on defaults, implicit ignore files, and protected paths before merge.

options.title: Narrow to explicit controls
options.body: Ask for only explicit opt-in exclude flags first, while deferring smart defaults, auto-detected ignore files, and broader restore policy to a separate decision.

options.title: Defer native scope changes
options.body: Keep native backup coarse for now and document plugin/workaround options, accepting that this issue remains a native CLI limitation until a later sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Review the linked native PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a replacement branch as the review vehicle, requiring real large-state proof and explicit decisions on defaults, implicit ignore files, and protected paths before merge.
